# tenzir_role (Resource)

A custom role of an organization. Assign it with `tenzir_role_assignment`.

Needs `Organization.createRole` and `OrganizationRole.read`, `OrganizationRole.update` and `OrganizationRole.delete`. The platform refuses a change that leaves no member able to restore access to the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenzir_role" "soc_reader" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  label           = "SOC reader"
  color           = "blue"
  description     = "Reads the SOC workspace."
  policy = jsonencode([
    [
      {
        target        = { _tag = "Workspace", orgId = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id, workspaceId = tenzir_workspace.soc.id }
        relationships = []
      },
      ["Workspace.read", "Workspace.readFileTree", "Workspace.readFile"],
    ],
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The display name.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `policy` (String) What the role grants, as JSON: an array of `[constraints, actions]` pairs, such as `[[{"target":{"_tag":"Workspace"},"relationships":[]},["Workspace.read"]]]`. The platform normalizes policies, merging grants with equal constraints and dropping actions a broader grant covers; a policy that normalizes alike shows no difference. Use `jsonencode` to write one.

### Optional

- `color` (String) The display color: one of `neutral`, `blue`, `green`, `lightblue`, `purple`, `pink`, `orange`, `yellow` or `red`. Defaults to `neutral`.
- `description` (String) What the role is for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization>/<role ID>, the organization an ID or a slug.
terraform import tenzir_role.soc_reader acme/01a1a205-ecd2-7121-a807-dc3038b41fed
```
